title: 2100 - Critters Wunderwussel!!!
author: Top-Face-5168
selftext:
I have made this Game with Claude Ai an im very Happy with the result...

Rip open card packs, flip your cards and discover toasters with elephant trunks, teapots with hedgehog spikes, vacuum cleaners with unicorn horns and a cow that flies its very own UFO. Many of them wear sunglasses, party hats, propeller caps or a fancy mustache, blow bubble gum or squint in the silliest way. Every critter has its own fantasy name, and some of them are really hard to find!

Playable Link: [https://berlinrider.itch.io/wonderwusel](https://berlinrider.itch.io/wonderwusel)  
  
An Android Test APK
